name: Buttercream
rw:note: Chocolate and vanilla buttercream share no quantities and no method: butter 250 g vs 200 g, sugar 500 g vs ~319 g, sugar added in three lots vs two, and milk goes from an optional thinner to a required structural ingredient. Neither is a variant of the other. They are siblings in a family, and a family carries no quantities of its own. Coffee buttercream IS a variant, because its patch touches one ingredient and no steps.
rw:familyNote: A browsing tag, not a resolution mechanism. Nothing resolves through a family: substituting chocolate buttercream for vanilla in a cake is something you do by reading both recipes, not something the resolver should attempt.
